segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, this is Mark from Northstar Analytics. Thanks for making time. I saw your note about adding the service desk team before the April go-live, so I figured we could just walk through seats and timing.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, thanks. We’re still targeting April 15. Right now we have 38 users in the platform, and we need to add 12 more for the service desk managers and leads.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, so that would take you to 50 total seats. Your current order is $82 per seat per month through November 30, and the same rate applies on the add-on if we coterm it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, and coterm means the new 12 seats just run from, what, April 1 through November 30?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Exactly. If we set the start date to April 1, the prorated amount for the 12 seats is $7,872 before tax. It would show as a separate line on the April invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. Can the invoice reference PO 44719? Our AP team is picky about that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, no issue. I’ll include PO 44719 on the order form and the invoice memo. Do you need net 30 like the current contract?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, net 30 is fine. Also, can those users be active for testing on April 8, or do we have to wait until the start date?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: We can provision them on April 8 for testing. Billing would still start April 1 since that’s the coterm start, but access can be turned on whenever your admin wants it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Send the order form to me and Luis, and I’ll get signature by Friday if legal doesn’t have questions.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send it over today with the 12-seat add-on, April 1 start, November 30 end date, net 30, and PO 44719 noted.
